page.layout: One title page, one block of centred lines; a two-column list of tractates in the middle; imprint line at the foot. No margin notes. A library stamp at lower right is not transcribed.

main_text.l: JOH. GEORGII FVESLINI
CONCLAVIA
ROMANA
RESERATA:
Sive
MYSTERIUM INIQUITATIS,
IN ELECTIONE PONTIFICUM ROMANORUM
conjunctim multò quàm hactenus à quocunque alio
pleniùs, atque ita detectum,
Ut praeter ea, quae, cum ad Electionem Pontificum Romanorum
propiùs pertinentia, hîc promitti, statim apparet, in compendio etiam
non paucorum Gallici, sed & Italici cumprimis, Idiomatis Authorum,
Simul exhibeantur
Integri quasi Tractatus :
I. DE VERO FICTOQUE PETRI VI. DE ELECTIONIBUS SIMO-
PRIMATU, sive DE VERIS EJUS NIACIS.
PRÆROGATIVIS ET MO- VII. DE PONTIFICIBUS ROM.
NARCHIA FICTITIA. SIMULTANEIS.
II. DE ITINERE & EPISCOPA- VIII. DE JOHANNA PAPISSA.
TU ROMANO EJUSDEM. IX. DE PONTIFICUM ROM.
III. DE SUCCESSIONE PONTI- PROBITATE.
FICUM ROM. IN DIGNITA- X. DE ERUDITIONE ET PRU-
TEM EJUSDEM EIDEMQUE DENTIA EORUNDEM.
TRIBUTAM. XI. DE VARIA QUOAD NOMEN
IV. DE HABENTIBUS JUS ELI- ET REM MUTATIONE UT
GENDI N. T. MINISTROS. ET MISERIA EORUNDEM.
V. DE ECCLESIÆ ROM. CAR- XII. DE NEPOTISMO EORUN-
DINALIBUS. DEM.
TIGURI,
Ex Typographeo Schaufelbergeriano, M DC XCI.

page.notes: Title page in red and black. Lines of the tractate list are set in two columns; they are given in reading order, left column first then right. The woodcut or library stamp at lower right is not transcribed. Some words in the italic lines are rendered with doubtful letters (for example "Pontificum", "cum", "hîc") but are read as printed.
